analyst.text: Chicago snapped an eight-game skid with an emotional overtime win over Atlanta on Friday, but they are on a back-to-back, the ground stop threatened their trip, and they have lost No. 4 pick Caleb Wilson for four to six weeks. Jalen Smith called the losing "demoralizing". Ayo Dosunmu faces his former team for the first time since the trade, and he has been thriving as a starter in Anthony Edwards' absence. The angle leans towards Minnesota.
